copy.heading: A tour of your home
body: The kitchen. The room with the kettle. Meals are made here, by somebody, every day. There is a dishwasher, which you may load. The cutlery basket goes in the bottom. Plates face the middle.
The living room. Where the family sit in the evening and talk. It contains a television, which also shows programmes that are not golf. There are four of these on at any one time.
The garden. A lawn with borders. It is not a practice green. The Programme has been made aware of the flag.
The downstairs loo. A toilet and a small sink. It is not a bag store, and a golf umbrella should not be propped behind the door, where it falls on guests.
The garage. Originally for a car. Now for golf. See the inventory on the next page.
